directAnswer: To connect a passkey, use your device's settings to add the passkey through the security options, ensuring your device supports passkey authentication.
summary: Connecting a passkey involves accessing security settings on your device and following the prompts to add your passkey for authentication.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: A passkey is a secure method for authentication that eliminates the need for traditional passwords. It uses cryptographic keys stored on your device.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: Steps may vary by device and operating system version.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.body: If you encounter issues, ensure your device's software is up to date and that the service you're connecting to supports passkeys.

steps.title: iOS Devices
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Passwords > Add Password > Use Passkey. Follow the prompts to create and connect your passkey.

steps.title: Android Devices
steps.detail: Open Settings > Security > Advanced > Passkeys. Tap 'Add Passkey' and follow the instructions to connect.

steps.title: Windows Devices
steps.detail: Navigate to Settings > Accounts > Sign-in options > Windows Hello. Select 'Add' under Passkeys and follow the setup process.

steps.title: Mac Devices
steps.detail: Open System Preferences > Users & Groups > Login Options. Click 'Set up' next to Passkeys and follow the prompts.

faqs.question: What if my device doesn't support passkeys?
faqs.answer: If your device doesn't support passkeys, consider updating your operating system or using a different device that does.

faqs.question: Can I use a passkey for multiple accounts?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use the same passkey for multiple accounts as long as the services support it.

faqs.question: What should I do if I forget my passkey?
faqs.answer: If you forget your passkey, you may need to reset your authentication settings or contact the service provider for recovery options.

caveats: Not all services support passkey authentication.
Device compatibility may vary based on the operating system version.
